item.title: Cadbury Dairy Milk Turkish Delight Chocolate Block | 180g
item.description: pImagine the snap of smooth, creamy milk chocolate giving way to a soft, rose-scented Turkish delight jelly centre - that first bite is pure magic. Cadbury Dairy Milk Turkish Delight Milk Chocolate Block 180g is a delicious celebration of flavour, where smooth and creamy Cadbury milk chocolate meets the delicate sweetness and gentle chew of real Turkish delight. It's floral, it's indulgent, and it lingers just long enough to make you smile. the best part? Sharing it. Passing this chocolate block across the couch, breaking off a row for a friend, or leaving a piece on someone's desk just because - that's where the real sweetness lives. Every square is an excuse to slow down and savour something together. The playful contrast of rich, melt-in-your-mouth chocolate and pillowy rose jelly makes each piece a little moment worth stretching out. At 180g, this chocolate block is made for generous hands and open hearts - because delicious things taste even better when they're enjoyed with the people you love most. COCOA LIFE PROGRAM AIMS TO IMPROVE THE LIVELIHOODS OF FARMING COMMUNITIES AND THE LANDSCAPES WHERE COCOA GROWS. Dairy Milk Turkish Delight contains Dairy Milk milk chocolate with Turkish delight jelly centre. liMilk Chocolate and Creamy Centre in Tasmania Sustainably Sourced Cocoa Cadbury Dairy Milk Turkish Delight Chocolate Block | 180g

item.title: Lindt Lindor Milk Chocolate Cornet | 333g
item.description: Wherever and whenever you take a LINDOR moment, it just seems to make life feel so much more sublime. When you unwrap LINDOR and break its delicate chocolate shell, the irresistibly smooth filling starts to melt gently carrying you away in a moment of bliss. LINDOR, created by the Lindt Master Chocolatiers. At Lindt, we take pride in the chocolate we have so passionately created since 1845. We aim to make the finest chocolate that is matched by equally high ethical and sustainability standards, taking care at every step from bean to bar. That way, you are able to wholeheartedly indulge your senses, every single time. Our sustainability program, the Lindt and Sprüngli Farming Program enables us to trace our cocoa beans right back to the farmers. This allows us to support farmers, their families and communities on the ground according to their specific local needs. 100% of our cocoa beans are traceable back to their origin and externally verified. liLindt LINDOR- smooth melting Milk chocolate truffles, 333g away into a moment of bliss with LINDOR smooth melting milk chocolate decades of expertise, the Lindt Master Chocolatiers capture perfection in Swiss chocolate. ideal gift for every occasion, from Valentine's Day to Easter, birthdays and Christmas, or for sharing with family & friends. Lindt Lindor Milk Chocolate Cornet | 333g

item.title: Milky Way Chocolate Bar Whipped Nougat | 45g
item.description: NOW IN A RECYCLABLE PAPER-BASED WRAPPER! When you need an out-of-this-world chocolate snack, unwrap a MilkyWay chocolate bar and enjoy a deliciously light and simple treat! This famous chocolate bar has been delighting the world since 1923, thanks to its yummy lightly whipped chocolate malt flavoured nougat enrobed in smooth milk chocolate. With no artificial colours and flavours, MilkyWay chocolate is the perfect bar for a mid-afternoon snack and for lunchboxes. Pack some melt-in-the-mouth MILKYWAY chocolates for family road trips, stash some in the pantry for TV snacks or why not whip up some iconic MilkyWay blondies, brownies or cookies! liLightly whipped chocolate malt flavoured nougat enrobed in smooth milk chocolate. in Recyclable PAPER-BASED PACKAGING. in Australia. delicious chocolate bar portions to snack on with a friend (or save for later)! chocolate bar also available in a Fun Size Share bag. Milky Way Chocolate Bar Whipped Nougat | 45g

item.title: L'Oreal Paris Age Perfect Classic Cream | 50mL
item.description: Discover the L'Oreal Paris Age Perfect Collagen Expert Moisturizer with SPF 15, an intensely hydrating face cream that provides a daily boost of Collagen Peptides + Niacinamide to intensely rehydrate and redensify maturing skin. The formula features Broad Spectrum SPF 15 sunscreen to help provide protection against two types of UV rays (UVA) that can cause skin damage and premature aging. This lightweight face cream provides all-day hydration, absorbs quickly into the skin and doesn't feel greasy or sticky throughout the day. Paraben and mineral oil free, suitable for sensitive skin. KEY INGREDIENTSCollagen - A natural protein abundantly present in the skin. It provides skin's strength, firmness, and bounce. After 50, the skin's collagen production slows which can lead to loss of volume and sagging. Peptides - Recommended by dermatologists, peptides are the building blocks of collagen and are key for its natural production in the skin. Our collagen peptides, along with the other ingredients in our powerful formula, help to lock in moisture, redensify and retighten skin. Niacinamide - Also known as Vitamin B3, this essential nutrient helps to brighten skin and minimise the visible appearance of age spots. VISIBLE RESULTSAfter 1 use, skin is intensely rehydrated and nourished. After 4 weeks, skin feels stronger, denser and contours appear more toned. Skin appearance more radiant and bright. liUVA Protection to reduce the appearance of age spots L'Oreal Paris Age Perfect Classic Cream | 50mL

item.description: Relieve the discomfort of common cold symptoms with Cenovis Chewable Triple Action Vit C, D & Zinc 60 Tablets. In addition, this convenient, chewable orange-flavoured supplement also maintains skin health and the formation of collagen, as well as supports minor wound healing. Proudly Australian Made from Cenovis, trusted by Australian families for over 80 years, Cenovis Chewable Triple Action Vit C, D & Zinc tablets are quality tested during manufacturing to ensure product consistency and potency. Cenovis Chewable Triple Action Vit C, D & Zinc contains no added gluten, lactose, artificial colours, dairy products, or animal-derived products.* Always read the label and follow the directions for use. item.title: Lindt Lindor Assorted Chocolate Balls Gift Box | 235g
item.description: Wherever and whenever you take a LINDOR moment, it just seems to make life feel so much more sublime. When you unwrap LINDOR and break its delicate chocolate shell, the irresistibly smooth filling starts to melt gently carrying you away in a moment of bliss. LINDOR, created by the Lindt Master Chocolatiers. At Lindt, we take pride in the chocolate we have so passionately created since 1845. We aim to make the finest chocolate that is matched by equally high ethical and sustainability standards, taking care at every step from bean to bar. That way, you are able to wholeheartedly indulge your senses, every single time. Our sustainability program, the Lindt and Sprüngli Farming Program enables us to trace our cocoa beans right back to the farmers. This allows us to support farmers, their families and communities on the ground according to their specific local needs. 100% of our cocoa beans are traceable back to their origin and externally verified. liLindt LINDOR - smooth-melting assorted chocolate truffles, 235g ideal gift for every occasion, from Valentine's Day to Easter, birthdays and Christmas. assortment of the finest Lindt milk, dark, white and hazelnut chocolate. decades of expertise, the Lindt Master Chocolatiers capture perfection in Swiss chocolate. away into a moment of bliss with our irresistibly smooth LINDOR assorted chocolate balls. Lindt Lindor Assorted Chocolate Balls Gift Box | 235g

item.title: Blackmores Vitamin D3 1000iu Immune Capsules | 200 Pack
item.description: Good health changes everything-support your daily wellbeing with Blackmores Vitamin D3 1000 IU. Vitamin D plays an important role in your health, especially when it comes to supporting bone integrity, muscle function and immune system health. This formula provides 1000 IU of vitamin D3, a form that helps your body absorb calcium, which is vital for maintaining bone mass and supporting healthy bone development. This is particularly important as we age, or if you have limited sun exposure. Blackmores Vitamin D3 also helps support muscle function and maintain immune system function, making it a valuable addition to your self-care routine-especially during the cooler months. It also helps maintain vitamin D levels in the body for those at risk of low vitamin D. It's also Halal certified, making it suitable for a variety of dietary preferences and needs. Take daily with food to support your health with confidence. liOne-a-day dose healthy bone growth muscle strength, function and health D helps absorption of dietary calcium which supports bone health. A diet deficient in calcium can lead to osteoporosis in later life general health and wellbeing Blackmores Vitamin D3 1000iu Immune Capsules | 200 Pack

item.title: L'Oreal Revitalift Resurfacing Cleanser | 150mL
item.description: KEY BENEFITS OF THE REVITALIFT LASER GLYCOLIC ACID CLEANSERThis Glycolic Acid exfoliating cleanser is suitable for daily use. Formulated with 3.5% Glycolic Acid, a renowned dermatological active, it's known for its effectiveness in smoothing and refining skin texture. 75% agree skin feels resurfaced 72% agree skin looks smoother after using Revitalift Laser Glycolic Acid Cleanser. Consumer Test, 68 women, results after 4 weeks. Consumer Test, 68 women, immediate results. GLYCOLIC ACID SKINCARE ROUTINEStep 1) Resurface & Renew: Gently massage Revitalift Laser Glycolic Acid Cleanser onto damp skin and rinse. Step 2) Hydrate & Protect: Experience the transformative power of Revitalift Laser Day Cream. This potent formula combines Pro-Retinol to help smooth wrinkles and renew skin texture, Hyaluronic Acid to intensely hydrate and plump the skin, and Vitamin Cg to boost radiance and visibly correct uneven skin tone. See visibly toned, firmer skin, replumped with moisture, a more even skin texture, and reduced fine lines and crow's feet. Step 3) Target Deep Wrinkles (PM): In the evening, after cleansing, apply Revitalift Laser Pure Retinol Night Serum. Formulated with the highest concentration of Pure Retinol from L'Oreal Paris, this serum is clinically proven to visibly reduce 100% of wrinkles, even deep ones. Step 4) Hydrate & Replenish (PM): Revitalift Laser Night Cream combines powerful ingredients, including Pro-Retinol to smooth wrinkles, Hyaluronic Acid to intensely hydrate and plump, and Vitamin Cg to boost radiance and even skin tone. Enjoy a more toned, firmer complexion with a more even skin texture. Fine lines, dark spots, and wrinkles appear reduced. li75% Agree skin feels resurfaced. agree skin looks smoother, more radiant skin L'Oreal Revitalift Resurfacing Cleanser | 150mL

item.description: If you're looking for a powerful deodorant for men that works as long and hard as you do, give Dove Men+Care Advanced Clean Comfort Antiperspirant Deodorant Roll On a try. It helps you stay fresh and dry no matter what comes your way, delivering 72 hours of powerful sweat and odour protection. Our alcohol-free formula contains moisturising cream to strengthen your skin against underarm rash and chafing, keeping your underarms comfortable all day. Tough on sweat, not on skin, this roll on deodorant leaves a subtle, clean scent that keeps you feeling fresh for longer. With better protection and care, you'll get the increased confidence you need to feel your best. br Men+Care celebrates a new definition of strength: one with care at its centre. Real strength is shown through the care you give to the people that matter - and that includes you. br best results, ensure your underarms are dry before applying. To maximise the technology of Dove Men+Care Advanced roll on deodorant, try applying at night. Not only does your body sweat more in the morning, but a hot shower also opens your pores, making it less receptive to any antiperspirant you apply afterwards. item.title: Dove Advanced 72hr Roll On Original | 50mL
item.description: Did you know that when you shave, of what you remove is skin? That means you also lose ceramides, the natural building blocks of your skin's protective barrier. Dove Advanced Care Original Antiperspirant Deodorant Roll-On goes beyond 72-hour sweat and odour protection to soothe, repair and nourish your skin after shaving. This roll-on deodorant is enriched with pro-ceramide to help repair your skin's barrier by replenishing lost moisture and ceramides. It's also formulated with triple moisturising technology and hyaluron to provide intense hydration for softer, smoother skin. The signature Dove Original scent is an instant pick-me-up that keeps you feeling fresh and confident all day. With no alcohol* added, you can be sure this antiperspirant will be kind to your skin while being tough on sweat. How to use: Apply to clean, dry skin in circular motions. For best results, apply at night when your skin is drier and cooler, allowing the formula to sink in even better. *ethyl alcoholliDove Advanced Care Original Antiperspirant Deodorant Roll-On provides 72 hours of effective sweat and odour protection with pro-ceramide, this roll-on deodorant helps repair your skin barrier after shaving antiperspirant uses triple moisturising technology and hyaluron to help retain moisture within your skin signature clean fragrance keeps you feeling confidently fresh all day alcohol-free* formula combines soothing care with advanced antiperspirant protection deodorant nourishes delicate underarm skin, leaving it feeling softer and smoother.*ethyl alcohol. Dove Advanced 72hr Roll On Original | 50mL

item.title: Dove Women Advanced Deodorant Roll On 72hr Antiperspirant Pomegranate | 50mL
item.description: table style=min-width: 25px;colgroupcol style=min-width: 25px; colspan=1 rowspan=1pDid you know that when you shave, 1 of what you remove is skin? That means you also lose ceramides, the natural building blocks of your skin's protective barrier. Dove Advanced Care Pomegranate & Lemon Verbena Antiperspirant Deodorant Roll-On goes beyond 72-hour sweat and odour protection to soothe, repair and nourish your skin after shaving. This roll-on deodorant is enriched with pro-ceramide to help repair your skin's barrier by replenishing lost moisture and ceramides. It's also formulated with triple moisturising technology and hyaluron to provide intense hydration for softer, smoother skin. The energising pomegranate and lemon verbena scent is an instant pick-me-up that keeps you feeling fresh and confident all day. With no alcohol* added, you can be sure this antiperspirant will be kind to your skin while being tough on sweat. How to use: Apply to clean, dry skin in circular motions. For best results, apply at night when your skin is drier and cooler, allowing the formula to sink in even better. Proudly Australian Made by Cenovis and trusted by Australian families for over 80 years, Cenovis EasySleep Valerian is quality tested during manufacturing to ensure product consistency and potency. Cenovis EasySleep Valerian contains no added gluten, lactose, sugar, artificial flavours, artificial colours, artificial sweeteners, or dairy products.* Always read the label and follow the directions for use. item.title: L'Oreal Paris Bright Reveal Tinted SPF 50 Light Fluid | 50mL
item.description: L'Oreal Paris Bright Reveal Tinted Fluid SPF 50 Light, a dermatologist-validated, lightweight formula designed to visibly brighten and even skin tone. DAILY UV PROTECTION IS ESSENTIAL FOR OPTIMAL CORRECTION:Did you know that up to 100% of dark spots are aggravated by UV rays?* Dermatologists emphasise that daily protection is crucial to combat premature aging, including dark spots, wrinkles, and uneven skin tone.*Effect of the sun on visible clinical signs of ageing Caucasian skin, flament & AL, 2013.A POWERFUL ANTI-DARK SPOT PROTECTION:-UV FILTERS: This advanced formula goes beyond basic SPF with broad spectrum SPF 50 to shield skin from damaging UVA and UVB rays and is infused with Niacinamide to visibly correct dark spots and prevent future dark spots.-3% NIANCINMIDE: Tinted coverage to cover and correct, even tone and illuminate skin.-4% [PIGMENTS + PEARLS]: A brightening ingredient that helps reduce the appearance of dark spots. IN A GLOWING TEXTURE MADE FOR EVERYDAY:The lightweight, tinted formula provides seamless coverage of imperfections for a flawless, natural-looking finish without clogging pores, making it ideal for sensitive skin.
